notes.title: 7/4 patch update
notes.content:
Thank you for playing "Love Live! Nijigasaki High School Idol Club TOKIMEKI Roadmap to Future".
In order to fix a bug that has been confirmed in this game, we will be distributing a patch with the following contents.

Patch details 
・Fixed a bug that some members' voices do not play when selecting “Melody” or ‘Members’ in “Extras” 
・Fixed a bug that the screen goes diagonal under certain conditions 
・Fixed a bug that the screen freezes under certain conditions 
・Fixed a bug that the text is not displayed 
・Fixed other minor bugs

Translated with DeepL.com (free version)
